text: The Climate Resilience Programme (CRP) is a targeted initiative by the Otago Regional Council aimed at reducing flood risks in the Lower Clutha and Lower Taieri regions of Otago, New Zealand. The program consists of four projects that combine engineered flood defenses with nature-supportive measures to address the increasing frequency and severity of heavy rainfall events. It was initiated as part of New Zealand's COVID-19 recovery infrastructure stimulus and extended through the Regional Infrastructure Fund established in 2024.
